brief.brief: Instrumental game exploration theme for Wildshard, a world that arrives one chunk at a time: wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. No vocals. 60-90 s, loopable (it will be trimmed to a bar-exact loop). The model composes freely - no required motif.
brief.title: Warm orchestral
brief.reference: Studio Ghibli (Joe Hisaishi) / Ori and the Blind Forest
brief.ace_caption: Warm cinematic orchestral exploration theme for a fantasy adventure video game, in the style of Joe Hisaishi's Studio Ghibli scores and Ori and the Blind Forest. A lyrical flute and oboe melody over legato strings, rippling harp arpeggios, soft French horns, celesta sparkle and a wordless choir pad swelling underneath; gentle timpani, no drum kit. Mood: wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Rich concert-hall reverb. Instrumental, no lead vocals. D major.
